clue.text: Something to remind us that we have been found out

definitions.text: Something to remind us that we have been found out

parts.words: Something to remind us that we have been found out
parts.note: 'found out' reads as caught in a lie, but here it means a caller found us not at home and left a token of the visit

explanation.surface: A guilty reminder that one's misdeeds have been discovered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Found out' wants to mean exposed; read it as 'found to be out', away from home, when someone called.
explanation.definitionFit: A caller who finds the household absent leaves a small printed card bearing their name as proof of the attempted call.

clue.text: Its fiery outbursts are highly spectacular

definitions.text: Its fiery outbursts are highly spectacular

parts.words: Its fiery outbursts are highly spectacular
parts.note: sounds like a hot-tempered person whose tantrums are dramatic, but describes a mountain that erupts high up

explanation.surface: Someone's temper tantrums are a sight to behold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Highly' is literal: the eruptions happen at a summit.
explanation.definitionFit: An erupting mountain throws out fire and lava from its peak, a spectacle seen from far off.

clue.text: Engaged as a shop-assistant, maybe

parts.note: 'engaged' first suggests hired or betrothed, but means busy attending to customers at the counter

explanation.surface: Someone has just been taken on to work in a shop.
explanation.definitionFit: A shop assistant occupied with a customer is attending to them at that moment.

clue.text: A citrus fruit agent excitedly going round Ireland

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go round the name for Ireland, holding it inside
letters moving excitedly are thrown into a new order, so agent is scrambled

parts.note: Erin is the poetic name for Ireland

explanation.surface: A secret agent gets worked up while touring Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'excitedly' rearranges AGENT into TANGE, and 'going round' puts it around ERIN.
explanation.definitionFit: This loose-skinned orange-coloured fruit is a variety of mandarin.

clue.text: Comparatively unused Scandinavian water-jug?

parts.note: N is the abbreviation for Norwegian, a Scandinavian
a ewer is a large pitcher for water

explanation.surface: A question about a jug of Nordic design.
explanation.definitionFit: Something less used than another is fresher, a comparative of 'new'.

clue.text: A fabulous horseman

parts.note: 'fabulous' suggests wonderful, but means from fable: a creature that is half man, half horse

explanation.surface: Praise for a superb rider.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this creature had a human torso on a horse's body, literally man and horse at once.

clue.text: Picks up the threads again about everything the prophet turns out?

annotationWithheld.why: Picks up the threads again about everything the prophet turns out? (7): RE (about) + SUM (everything) leaves ES, which no reading of 'the prophet turns out' supplies; possibly OCR garble, no source found
annotationWithheld.clue: Picks up the threads again about everything the prophet turns out?

clue.text: What the firemen had when the roof nearly fell on them?

definitions.text: What the firemen had when the roof nearly fell on them?

parts.words: What the firemen had when the roof nearly fell on them
parts.note: describes a near miss, with a hint that a fire escape in a burning building is a tight one

explanation.surface: Firefighters were nearly crushed by a collapsing roof.
explanation.definitionFit: A close shave from danger is described as getting away by a hair's breadth.

clue.text: I get into real trouble on a wing flap

indicators.note: the letter I gets into the scrambled letters, sitting inside them
real in trouble is disturbed, its letters rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone admits to a real mess over some aircraft part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trouble' rearranges REAL into ALER; 'get into' puts I inside to make AILER, then ON follows.
explanation.definitionFit: This hinged surface on an aircraft's trailing edge controls roll.

clue.text: American apple we associate somehow with Spain

indicators.note: 'somehow' says the letters are combined in some unstated way, signalling a rearrangement of we and Spain

explanation.surface: A US apple that we link with Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: A red-skinned eating apple variety grown in the United States.

clue.text: A merger of journals celebrating two years of union activities?

definitions.text: A merger of journals celebrating two years of union activities?

parts.words: A merger of journals celebrating two years of union activities
parts.note: sounds like newspapers merging or trade-union business, but means the anniversary of a marriage, its traditional gift being paper

explanation.surface: Two newspapers combine to mark two years of trade-union work.
explanation.walkthrough: Each wedding anniversary has a traditional material; the second is paper. 'Union' is the marriage, not a trade union.
explanation.definitionFit: Couples marking their second anniversary traditionally exchange gifts made of paper.

clue.text: Get to know about a tissue of lies

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: a tissue of lies is a web of them, the weaving signalling that the letters of lies are interlaced into a new order

explanation.surface: Learning about a web of untruths.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tissue of' rearranges LIES into LISE, after RE and A.
explanation.definitionFit: To come to understand something is to grasp or become aware of it.

clue.text: Useful stand-by for the person who doesn't know which way to turn

definitions.text: Useful stand-by for the person who doesn't know which way to turn

parts.words: Useful stand-by for the person who doesn't know which way to turn
parts.note: 'which way to turn' sounds like someone at their wits' end, but means a lost driver at a junction

explanation.surface: Advice for someone who is at a loss what to do.
explanation.definitionFit: A chart of streets and highways tells a lost driver which direction to take.

clue.text: Not just any kind of injury?

definitions.meaning: a legal term for any harm done to someone

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both unfair and a harm or injustice done to someone, as in suffering an injury.

clue.text: Something that is hard to rub out

definitions.text: Something that is hard to rub out

parts.words: Something that is hard to rub out
parts.note: seems to describe a stubborn stain, but describes a hard abrasive rubber that does the rubbing out

explanation.surface: A remark about a mark that resists removal.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'hard' as describing the object, a gritty rubber, not the difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: A gritty rubber block removes pen marks from paper.

clue.text: The art of giving a ruling

definitions.text: The art of giving a ruling

parts.words: The art of giving a ruling
parts.note: 'giving a ruling' suggests a judge's decision, but means ruling as a monarch

explanation.surface: A description of how a judge pronounces judgement.
explanation.definitionFit: The skill of governing as a monarch, statecraft practised by a sovereign.

clue.text: Simple and fresh colour

parts.note: a simple is a medicinal herb, and sage is one
green means fresh or new

explanation.surface: A plain, crisp shade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Simple' looks like an adjective but is the old noun for a medicinal herb.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft greyish shade named after the leaves of a culinary herb.

clue.text: An artisan who needs glasses

parts.note: suggests a short-sighted craftsman, but means one whose trade uses panes of glass

explanation.surface: A craftsman with poor eyesight.
explanation.definitionFit: This tradesman cuts and fits panes into windows.

clue.text: Egg-cells from Maesteg, possibly

indicators.note: possibly says these letters could form something else, so Maesteg is rearranged

explanation.surface: Ova sourced from a Welsh town.
explanation.walkthrough: Maesteg is a town in South Wales; 'possibly' rearranges its letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Reproductive cells, ova or sperm, which fuse in fertilisation; an egg cell is one kind.

clue.text: Award for a priest of unusual merit?

indicators.note: something unusual is out of the ordinary, so the letters of merit appear in an unusual order

explanation.surface: A clergyman is honoured for exceptional service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of unusual' rearranges MERIT; 'of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop's tall pointed headdress, given when a priest is raised to that office.

clue.text: A French painter takes it up en masse

indicators.note: the word masse takes the reversed piece inside it

parts.note: taken as written from the phrase en masse

indicators.note: in a down clue, 'up' means the word it is read from bottom to top

explanation.surface: An artist joins in with everyone at once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns IT into TI, which 'takes' places inside MASSE; 'en' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Henri Matisse was the leading Fauvist artist of France.

clue.text: Mediterranean vessels checked in the Highlands?

definitions.meaning: single-masted sailing boats of the Mediterranean, also spelt tartanes
checked cloth patterns of Scottish clans

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both small lateen-rigged Mediterranean boats and the plaid cloths of Scottish clans.

clue.text: A member led out in a state of apprehension

indicators.note: led is spread out, opened up so that another piece sits within it

parts.note: taken as written
an arm is a member, a limb of the body

explanation.surface: A man led away in a worried state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' opens LED around ARM, giving L-ARM-ED after A.
explanation.definitionFit: Frightened or anxious, fearing danger.

clue.text: Exploits that have to be witnessed

definitions.meaning: legal documents whose signing needs a witness

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both great feats and legal documents conveying property, which must be signed before a witness.

clue.text: Made provisional arrangements

parts.note: 'provisional' suggests temporary, but means to do with provisions, food

explanation.surface: Someone set up a temporary plan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Provisional' means relating to provisions, food supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: Supplying food for an event is arranging its provisions.

clue.text: A letter that is spelt incorrectly

indicators.note: a word spelt incorrectly has its letters in the wrong order

parts.note: i.e. abbreviates id est, that is

explanation.surface: A note containing a spelling mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal letter, especially one of the New Testament letters of the apostles.

clue.text: Forbear to give a sailor a black mark?

parts.note: AB is an able-bodied seaman
a stain is a blemish on one's record

explanation.surface: Refraining from reprimanding a seaman.
explanation.definitionFit: To refrain or hold back from doing something, such as voting.

clue.text: Game dogs they are, those Dublin composers!

definitions.text: Game dogs they are, those Dublin composers!

parts.words: Game dogs they are, those Dublin composers
parts.note: composers are typesetters in printing, so Dublin's typesetters share a name with a red gun-dog breed

explanation.surface: Praise for plucky Irish musicians.
explanation.walkthrough: A composer, in printing, sets type: a setter. Setters are also gun dogs used for game birds.
explanation.definitionFit: A red-coated gundog breed from Ireland used to point game birds.
